title: Umunsi w'Imurikagurisha rya Nyuma
intro: Bahamagawe mu kwerekana imbaraga zikomeye, itsinda ry'abahanzi b'abahanga bahuye n'ukuri batari biteze kwahindura ubuzima bwabo burundu.
clues: Twari tuzwiho ubuhanga bwacu, ubuhanga mu gukoresha amayeri no mu buhanga.
Twahamagawe n'umutegetsi kugira ngo tujye guhangana n'umuntu wari ufite inkoni yoroheje.
Ubwo twabonaga ukuri, twaguye hasi twunamye, dutangaza ko twemera Nyagasani w’isi.
Uwo mugome yaduteye ubwoba ko azaduhana bikomeye, ariko ntitwatengushye.
Twari mu ba mbere bemeye ubutumwa nyuma yo kubona ikimenyetso gisobanutse neza.
Twahowe Imana duhowe ukwizera kwacu, ariko tuzaba aba mbere kwinjira muri Paradizo hamwe n'abakiranutsi.
arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
